raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Some raw_customers rows carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. raw_region_map gives the mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), but silver_customers only upper-cases the value and never applies it.
